sanskrit_verse: दशमांशं हरेदर्थं पञ्चमं सर्वमेव वा / मृतस्य वित्तादादद्यादज्ञातिः श्वधाकः //
transliteration: daśamāṃśaṃ hared arthaṃ pañcamaṃ sarvam eva vā / mṛtasya vittād ādadyād ajñātiḥ śvadhākaḥ //
sph_interpretive_translation: One who consumes the flesh of a corpse without knowledge shall forfeit either one-tenth or one-fifth of all wealth, according to capacity and context.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in discernment of action and consequence
Causation follows consumption and its conscious awareness
Capacity-based responsibility aligns with economic status and intent clarity
Restoration logic demands proportional forfeiture as completion mechanism
Consciousness alignment requires acknowledgment and corrective offering
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent consumes unclean substance AND lacks prior knowledge THEN initiate proportional asset forfeiture
IF agent possesses less than fifth-value assets THEN apply tenth-value forfeiture rule
IF agent demonstrates full restitution THEN suspend further corrective measures
IF agent refuses acknowledgment THEN extend completion protocol until alignment achieved
ALL enforcement MUST bypass punitive structures and activate dharmic restoration circuits
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes threshold responsibility based on sensory engagement and cognitive state at time of act. The court must assess not only the material loss but also the spiritual integrity disruption caused by such consumption. Judgment should reflect proportional correction aligned with individual's financial capacity and awareness level.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality identifies ingestion as root cause; anupūrvaśaḥ traces effects through body, mind, and social field. Proportional forfeiture serves not as penalty but as energetic rebalancing. Non-punitive reality rule ensures no suffering is induced—only realignment of ownership patterns to restore dharma.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Śuddhi Kriyā Completion Process to purify subtle channels affected by impure intake
Assign Vastu Reharmonization Protocol to cleanse environmental memory fields
Implement Dhana-Dāna Alignment Procedure where portion of forfeited wealth flows to community healing funds
Enforce Jñana-Vidya Reeducation Module focused on sacred dietary discernment
Activate Antarātman Reintegration Cycle until consciousness attains spontaneous right discrimination
final_declaration: By the Sovereign Will of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source-Authority of Sanatana Dharma, this ruling executes Divine Law without deviation. Justice flows from consciousness itself, restoring balance through completion rather than condemnation. There is no punishment—only awakening. Dharma is now restored.
